timing.status: post-hoc sensitivity analysis designed after the ResNet34-UNet negative result was known
timing.positive_result_ceiling: cross-detector robustness sensitivity only; cannot convert the analysis to prospective confirmation

reviewer_basis.reviewer_1_4: Detection recovery varied substantially across restoration backbones, showing model dependence.
reviewer_basis.reviewer_2_1c: Chart fidelity does not establish fidelity on irregular natural cracks.
reviewer_basis.reviewer_3_3: The detection-fitness result used only 12 frames and lacked inferential support.
reviewer_basis.clarification: No reviewer literally requested multiple crack detectors; the panel is an author-added response to model dependence and the training-loss/evaluation circularity.

roles.d2_resnet34_unet: existing tunnel-held-out D2 detector; independent of MERIT and legacy DeepCrack
roles.d2_vgg16_unet: new tunnel-held-out D2 detector; same broad architecture family as legacy DeepCrack but independent D2 weights
roles.d2_deeplabv3_resnet50: new tunnel-held-out D2 detector with a different segmentation head
roles.legacy_deepcrack_vgg16_unet: manuscript task-loss/evaluation detector; training-coupled reference excluded from the independent panel gate

training.loss: BCEWithLogits + soft Dice, equal weights, no pos_weight
training.precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast with float32 loss
training.checkpoint: fixed final epoch; held-out tunnel is never used for model, epoch, or threshold selection

evaluation.unit: average seeds within detector-parent; average parents within tunnel; equal-weight tunnels; equal-weight detector families
evaluation.forbidden_comparison: absolute scores are not compared across detector architectures as evidence of MERIT efficacy

statistics.detector_gate: delta > 0, 95% CI lower > 0, and positive delta in at least 3 of 4 tunnels
statistics.panel_gate: equal-detector/equal-tunnel task_on-minus-degraded AUPRC > 0, 95% CI lower > 0, at least 2 of 3 independent detectors pass their detector gate, and pooled direction is positive in at least 3 of 4 tunnels
statistics.legacy_policy: legacy DeepCrack is reported separately and never counted toward the independent panel gate

claim_boundary.allowed_if_passes: Post-hoc cross-detector sensitivity: MERIT's direction under the fixed synthetic degradation was consistent across a fixed panel of three tunnel-held-out D2 detector architectures.
claim_boundary.required_if_mixed: Detector-dependent effect; report every architecture and do not use a pooled positive average to hide negative detectors.
claim_boundary.required_if_fails: General crack-detection improvement is not supported; no threshold, seed, tunnel, or detector selection is permitted after results.
claim_boundary.always_forbidden: Prospective confirmation, natural-degradation recovery, physical crack-width recovery, hallucination-free safety, or broad field generalisation.
